items.t: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM) May Make Its $22.6 Billion Texas Plant Conditional
items.sum: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE:TSM) is weighing a US$22.6b chip fabrication plant in Texas tied to new tax rules. The proposed facility in Austin depends on pending state property tax breaks and federal incentives still under consideration.
